course_title: Community and Public Health Nutrition Practice
course_description: This course allows students to translate community and public health nutrition theory into practice. It will provide students with a 20-day placement experience in a community and public health setting. Students will undertake a project that may include elements of planning, implementing, and evaluating community and public health nutrition programs, stakeholder engagement or science communication.

course_aims: This course aims to develop advanced skills and practice in community and public health nutrition that is relevant to dietetics professionals

learning_outcomes.description: Apply key theories, frameworks and evidence related to community and public health nutrition in practice
Demonstrate the ability to plan, implement or evaluate community and public health nutrition programs
Apply quality management principles in a community and public health nutrition context
Apply a professional, ethically responsible and culturally safe approach to practice in a community and public health setting
Communicate and collaborate effectively to diverse stakeholders, groups and communities
